title: Dark Iron Textures
description: Changes iron related blocks and items to match the dark color of anvils and cauldrons
body:
# Dark Iron Textures
This texture pack tints all the iron related blocks and items to the same color palette, that anvils and cauldrons use. The only exception are tools and weapons.  
No more mistaking iron for silver!  

Get a quick overview in this video from 4:24 to 5:30:
